claims.text: Baconi: Hamas a chapter of the Muslim Brotherhood that began as social network; spun off at the first intifada; came to believe armed force is the only way to compel Israel to end the occupation; an Islamic Palestinian national movement engaged in 'armed resistance against a colonial force'.
Hoffman: Hamas's aims are set by its ideology, not the occupation; the 1988 covenant 'spells out clearly Hamas's genocidal intentions'; the 2017 text changes language without changing core aims.

sources.label: PBS Amanpour & Company, 'Historian Tareq Baconi on the origins and future of Hamas', 25 Oct 2023
Bruce Hoffman, 'Understanding Hamas's genocidal ideology', The Atlantic, 12 Oct 2023 (repost)
